meta.title: DashElectrify
meta.subtitle: The 35-by-35 electrification pledge, country by country
sources: COP31 Presidency pledge registry, status as of 2026-11-23
World Bank World Development Indicators, API, last updated 2026-11-11

plans.document: Powering Canada Strong: A National Strategy for an Electrified Canadian Economy
plans.publisher: Natural Resources Canada
plans.summary: National electrification strategy plus an action plan. CAD 115 billion for electrification to 2041-42, including CAD 52 billion in Budget 2026. Aims to double electricity supply by 2050.

plans.publisher: Government of China
plans.summary: Sets an indicative target of 35% electricity in final energy consumption by 2030, up from 30% in 2025. Repeated in the New-type Power System Five-Year Plan in August 2026. Document date is month-level.

plans.publisher: Ministry of Water and Energy
plans.summary: Universal access by 2035, about 4.4 million off-grid connections, and a financing need above USD 18 billion, roughly 61% expected from external partners.

plans.document: Plan d'electrification des usages (Electrifions la France)
plans.publisher: Government of France, Ministry of Economy and Finance
plans.summary: 22 measures across nine ministries to move transport, buildings and industry off gas and oil. A second phase of 17 measures followed on 15 October 2026.

plans.publisher: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources
plans.summary: The national energy plan revision was still in public consultation on 30 October 2026, with adoption by presidential regulation pending. Not yet published.

plans.publisher: Department of Climate, Energy and the Environment
plans.summary: Maps about 130 existing policies, programmes and regulatory measures across heat, transport and industry. Phase 1 is a baseline; a Phase 2 action plan is to follow.

plans.document: Kenya National Electrification Strategy (KNES 2025) with compact implementation roadmap
plans.publisher: Ministry of Energy and Petroleum
plans.summary: KNES 2025 is in force and being operationalised through the Mission 300 compact, targeting 5.1 million additional household connections and 100% access by 2030.

plans.publisher: Ministry of Mineral Resources and Energy
plans.summary: Assigns each settlement to grid, mini-grid or standalone solar as the cheapest route to power, launched with an integrated electrification platform.

plans.document: National Transport Policy 2026 (2083 BS) and National Strategy for Electrification of Public Transport
plans.publisher: Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport
plans.summary: Declares an EV Decade, prioritises electric mass transit and sets the EV policy framework. Transport sector only, not a whole-economy plan. Date is month-level.

plans.publisher: Ministry of Energy and Mines, DGER
plans.summary: Long-running national rural electrification plan, targeting about 90% rural coverage in 2026. Not a new 2026 publication.

plans.publisher: Department of Energy with BARMM
plans.summary: DOE and the Bangsamoro government are developing a consolidated total electrification roadmap against a 100% electrification goal. No published national plan found.

plans.publisher: Ministry of Infrastructure and Rwanda Energy Group
plans.summary: The revised NEP was expected to be approved in 2026 under the Mission 300 compact, targeting a 75% grid and 25% off-grid mix.

plans.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
plans.summary: Brings networks, buildings, transport and industry into one national account of the shift to clean electricity, framed against the COP31 35-by-35 objective.

plans.publisher: Ministry of Energy
plans.summary: Successor to the 2008 master plan, setting rural electrification sequencing and targets to 2030. Date is month-level.

plans.summary: Indicative target of 46% electricity in final energy by 2040, against about 23% today, with 32% by 2030 as reference. A bloc instrument, not a country plan.

plans.document: Carbon Neutrality and Growth Plan 2026-2035 (energy transition, not electrification)
plans.publisher: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment
plans.summary: Endorsed the 35-by-35 pledge on 11 November 2026. Published a 10-year 2026-2035 carbon neutrality and growth plan worth KRW 1,000 trillion. It is an energy transition plan, not an electrification plan, so no electrification roadmap is identified.
